Matilda Gomez: hi team! matilda here 1% remote, starting today as a solutions engineer. tiny first-week checklist q: laptop says 'label created' on the portal, is that normal? who should I ping for access to demo clusters and the staging VPC? also a fun fact: i painted a mural on my apartment building last summer (long story). :art:

Eliot Shaw: welcome matilda!! i'm your onboarding buddy 0% i'll DM you a 30m walkthrough. ping @Ravi Patel for demo cluster creds; i'll add eng-infra-bot in the thread for any automations. :tada:

Ravi Patel: hey matilda 0% congrats and welcome. created ticket IT-5347 to track laptop + temp access. for staging VPC access i've started the approval flow (approvers: infra-leads). if you need immediate access, reply and IT can spin a temp dev box.

Dev Support Bot: Ticket IT-5347 updated: Temporary cloud instance provisioned (ubuntu-22.04). SSH: mgomez@temp-dev-521.redwood.internal. Key placed in 1Password under "IT Temp Keys". Laptop status: "shipped".

Matilda Gomez: amazing, thanks everyone. SSH worked. any recommended first-day reading or a quick doc that summarizes our demo infra?

Eliot Shaw: start with /onboarding/demo-runbook and the "demo-config-quickstart" in the repo. i'll share a tiny script in the DM that preloads sample data. weekly team intro is Fri 2pm PT but no pressure if timezone mismatch.

Nora (People Ops): welcome matilda! we have a virtual meet-and-greet at 11am PT tomorrow where new hires share one odd skill. mural sounds perfect 1% bring a photo if you can. also sent the swag kit form.

Matilda Gomez: will do 1% i'll upload a pic of the mural after the 11am meet. excited to join and learn the ropes :rocket:
